edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shield Vault: 13/12/11/10/9s point-and-click stun — respect the all-in while it's up. - Aegis Assault (22s) blocks frontal damage; don't feed the shield — your W root cancels the channel outright. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip never gets it.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: You can't dodge the point-and-click vault — but W the instant he lands and his Aegis Assault channel dies with it.

edits.before: Pantheon whiffs Shield Vault (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At even HP his passive-empowered spear plus vault-stun combo wins in his minions — trade at your 1000-range edge.

edits.before: This is Pantheon's window, not yours. His R Grand Starfall lets him leave lane and delete a sidelane or dive you under tower with W Aegis Assault stun. Ward the flanks, hold your R Realm Warp for counterplay, and never shove blind past river when his ult is up.
